newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends firmer on expected dollar inflow.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends firmer on expected dollar inflow.

text.p: The won closed slightly higher against the dollar on Wednesday as sentiment improved on expectations of dollar inflow from depository receipt issues, traders said.
The won ended at 829.60 after opening at 830.00 and staying in a 829.40-830.50.
Cho Hung Bank will issue $180 million global depository receipts in London late Wednesday.
Traders said the won weakened in early trading in line with the dollar strength against the Japanese yen elsewhere.
Expected month-end export deals and inflow of dollars from Cho Hung's depository receipts issue boosted the local unit, traders said.
Dealers said the market would be affected heavily when Cho Hung starts selling dollars from the receipts issue.
The won is expected to move in a 828.50-830.80 range on Thursday. The central bank set the base mid-rate at 829.90 for Thursday against 829.00 for Wednesday.
